end_basis: Nearest MAVROS recorder wall timestamp to final judge log mtime; uncertainty about 0.040 seconds.
limitations: One randomized trial; 462.32 seconds does not meet the 3-4 minute objective.
All eight recorded gimbal handoffs expired; no bino_acquired feedback before finish.
White remained visible around ROS 1980 but projection quality rejected further positions; follow-up remains required.
Late edge red discovery/tracking delay remains under investigation.
UAV 0 climb stall and UAV 3 suspected crash recovery alerts require review; sampled sensors cannot prove absence of contact.
Sculpture secondary verifier was enabled on all six main cameras; this trial alone does not prove elimination of sculpture false positives.
Raw records include post-finish flight and shutdown; summaries stop at evaluation_end_ros.
Camera samples are periodic JPEGs, not every inference frame or continuous video.
Local red1/t5 labels may be reused and are not official actor identities.
